Are you passionate about designing cutting-edge digital electronics for the space industry?
We are expanding our teams in the Aerospace Sector in Romania , and we are looking for a highly skilled FPGA and SoC Digital Electronics Engineer to join our team, where you'll grow your skills and play a crucial role in developing advanced technologies for space flight equipment . If you have needed background in VHDL , FPGA and experience with SoC HW/SW co-developments , we want to hear from you!
We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website
 WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?
 You will join the team behind the computer-vision co-processing FPGA board for ESA's HERA mission navigating to Dydimos binary asteroid! We've developed this cutting-edge technology, fully implementing FPGA code to accelerate image processing for vision-based autonomous navigation and integrating the high-speed interfaces required for space exploration.
Be a part of a project that's not just out of this world, but leading the way in space innovation!
 WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?
 We are looking for engineers with expertise in FPGA design, in particular in coding VHDL f or FPGA development and FPGA design tools and methodologies , knowledge in SoC Development (hands-on experience with SoC FPGA platforms, Hardware/software co-development, including embedded systems) and experience in Digital Electronic with a strong understanding of digital electronics design principles.
It will be a nice to have previous experience in the space industry or similar high-reliability sectors and understanding of radiation-hardened electronics design as well as software Integration (C/C++ for embedded systems), real-time operating systems (RTOS) and hardware abstraction layers (HAL).
 WHAT DO WE OFFER?
 🕑 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.
 💻 Flexible start and finish times.
 🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.
🌍 National and international mobility . Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package .
💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews .
💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee , physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!
⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com
❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
